name: MoGe-3
paper_title: MoGe-3: Fine-Detail Monocular Geometry Estimation with Self-Guided Sparse Volumetric Refinement
license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license, so the MoGe-3 code and weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products; the only obligation is to keep the copyright and license notice with copies. LibreYOLO ports the forward pass, sparse refinement and camera recovery from microsoft/MoGe at commit 74fbce054ebed49800de42d0ad0e83495065719a (MIT, Copyright Microsoft Corporation), re-expresses the FlexGEMM sparse kernels in plain PyTorch without vendoring them (FlexGEMM is MIT), and follows MIT utils3d helpers; the DINOv2 backbone keeps its separate Apache-2.0 attribution (libreyolo/models/moge3/NOTICE). The official checkpoints Ruicheng/moge-3-vitl (revision 184008f877d7ad1ad4c2cd2182a9bd1f63d0e5be) and Ruicheng/moge-3-vitg (revision 6ef26c5a4b4148dab5ccaacdb08b72dc66380475) declare MIT; LibreYOLO mirrors them unchanged, plus checkpoint metadata, as LibreYOLO/LibreMoGe3{l,g}-{depth,normal}, not gated.
